name: Structural Focus+Context Rendering
definition: A volume rendering system that outlines structural relationships between different classification criteria of a multiclassified voxel model by clustering voxels, constructing a directed graph of classification relationships, and applying structural focus+context shading via multimodal 3D texture mapping.
summary: Structural Focus+Context Rendering is a volume visualization technique that models logical relationships between classification criteria using a directed graph to compute transfer functions based on boolean queries.
